_comment: Source registry (tech plan §15.3; PD-0027 / PD-0028 / PD-0031 / PD-0032 / PD-0033). Committed. A terms_check records the human product owner's decision on whether that source's terms of use permit INTERNAL DEVELOPMENT use: {"checked_by": "<name>", "checked_on": "YYYY-MM-DD", "permits_internal_development_use": true|false, "notes": "..."}. The loader refuses any file from a source without a permitting check (SOURCE_TERMS_NOT_ATTESTED). The 2026-10-01 checks adopt the main session's reading of each source's published terms, at the owner's instruction (PD-0031); the owner may revise any entry. upstream_provider and independence_group remain the main session's best knowledge where marked TO CONFIRM; two sources in one independence_group count as ONE source for reconciliation.

sources.name: Alpha Vantage free tier (US daily history)

terms_check.checked_by: the product owner, adopting the main session's reading
terms_check.notes: Re-checked under PD-0032: personal, non-commercial use, which this is; internal development use permitted. Conditions: no redistribution or display to others; free-key limits apply (25 requests/day; compact output = last 100 sessions). Was false under PD-0031 (commercial premise); any commercial use needs re-attestation. PD-0064: this use includes local storage, archive, the owner's own report export and reproduction; 'others' excludes the owner and the project's agents (PD-0028). A reading of the published terms, not legal advice. Every download needs its own owner approval. PD-0066 decision 5: annual term, renewing unless 30 days' notice; access ends at termination; the terms are silent on data already downloaded; the owner chose the X1 lease, all rights off at termination or lapse. PD-0072: term start 2026-10-01, term_end_not_after 2027-10-01T00:00:00Z, F1 lease valid_until 2027-09-01 (Asia/Shanghai). The full readings are in those PDs.
